session_contract.array_item: single session-id key mapped to a non-empty event array
session_contract.timestamp: timezone-aware ISO-8601 normalized to UTC Z
session_contract.ordering: source event order is durable tie-break; canonical order is timestamp, durable order, event identity
session_contract.cross_file: merge by exact session_id with source-member provenance; conflicting duplicates fail closed

high_interaction_policy.eligibility: all events in a session must have the exact value

command_events.outcome_pairing: contextual_unpaired_only; no authoritative pairing without source event identity
command_events.input_extraction: event.input when present, otherwise exact CMD: message prefix
command_events.outcome_extraction: Command found:/Command not found: message is retained only as contextual digest

forbidden: raw command text in safe output
privacy.private_classifier_stream: ephemeral only; never publish or persist
